const SCALE = 2;

function double(value) {
  return value * SCALE;
}

function quadruple(value) {
  return double(double(value));
}

function describe(value) {
  return String(quadruple(value));
}

function label(value) {
  return "n=" + describe(value);
}

function readout(value) {
  return label(quadruple(value));
}
